question: What is the fixed six-library geometry of a declared exon-hit transformation after structural input qualification, without interpreting source labels as independent animal effects?
decision: Complete a bounded technical sample-profile diagnostic from the original PCA subjob while retaining its difference from author gene-level VST/plotPCA and leaving biological comparisons unestimated.
strongest_rival: Exon counting semantics, library composition/depth and unknown pool linkage can drive sample-profile structure; a plot can be mistaken for a biological effect or author outlier decision.
discriminator: Fixed all-feature transformation and full SVD, all six samples retained, source labels preserved, independent covariance/Gram arithmetic; no group test, variable-feature selection or gene loading output.
exposure_record: Paper, source metadata, human results and structural QC are exposed. Structural run confirms same406850exon features and143437all-zero rows. This prospective diagnostic has not yet been fitted to real source profiles; synthetic tests only before freeze.
biological_unit: Measured entities are six deposited libraries. Animal or independently collected pool identities/overlap remain unknown; no animal-level or pool-effect inference.
nesting_and_overlap: Rows nest in libraries; source-labeled libraries may contain pooled/overlapping material. No library or row is promoted to an independent animal.
population_and_selection: All six baseline exon-count libraries GSM9964554–GSM9964559. Retain every non-summary exon-bin row except rows zero across all six libraries. No low-count/HVG/condition-based filter, group selection or sample exclusion.
contrast: No biological group contrast. Sample coordinates and fractions of transformed variance only.
endpoint: Six-library coordinates from feature-centered log2(1+1e6*bin count/sum of all non-summary exon-bin counts), with full deterministic SVD and transformed variance fractions.
methods: Use only the structurally qualified fixed exon universe. Remove all-zero rows only. Normalize each library by all exon-bin hits, take log2(1+CPM), center each feature across all six libraries, compute full SVD; sign convention makes the largest absolute sample coordinate positive. Independently check covariance eigenvalues, all-component Gram reconstruction and feature centering. Export coordinates/variance/plot only; do not export gene loadings or ranks.
missingness_and_exclusions: Five underscore count-summary categories do not enter exon-hit denominator. All-zero feature removal is fixed and checked against QC. No library exclusion or altered cutoff. Stop unqualified/nonpositive/negative/misaligned or numerically constant profiles; do not rescue by selecting features.
multiplicity: No hypothesis tests, confidence intervals or biological group effects. Variance fractions are technical properties of this fixed transformation.
precision_basis: Floating-point verification only, not population precision or an effect margin.
interpretation_limit: This is an exon-bin technical adaptation. Author Methods specify unspecified low-overall-count filtering, DESeq2v1.48.2 VST and plotPCA; it is not their exact gene-level PCA or a recovered outlier rule. Exon-hit sums are not unique fragments; unknown independent units and full N.brasiliensis-history/later-IAV context remain explicit. No infection-response prediction, named-target loading/ranking or intervention prioritization.
stop_rule: Stop failure of structural qualification, input/hash/axis/source-label agreement, nonpositive denominator, invalid integer count or independent arithmetic. Preserve any failure rather than change filters or remove samples.
amendment_reason: Separate prospective descriptive technical diagnostic cleared after structural QC; does not extend the metadata run into biological effects or claim author-PCA reproduction.
